fact: PeeringDB's record for Michcom-IX, an open-access carrier-neutral exchange in Freetown run by Michcom Limited, lists 5 peers (Afcom SL, AI Networks, Fiber One SL, Michcom, route servers), 6 connections and 60G total capacity, with points of presence at Zoodlabs CLS MMR in Freetown and Leonecom MMR in Jui; operator-maintained record last updated 2026-06-03.

The operator's own site describes Michcom-IX as Sierra Leone's first IXP, with 15 networks peering, 50G total switching capacity and four live points of presence (Freetown, Jui, Conakry, Monrovia); the page is undated, so the 2025 capture year is used.

The operator's own site says a Microsoft Connected Cache node caches Microsoft content locally at the exchange, and Quad9 DNS is hosted on-net behind Michcom AS209049; page undated, 2025 capture year used.

The operator's own site says operators across Sierra Leone, Guinea and Liberia are exchanging traffic at Michcom-IX, with live points of presence in Conakry (Guilab) and Monrovia (CCL); page undated, 2025 capture year used.
